defects.title: A knock-out that makes the model infeasible stops the function with an error
defects.trigger: a population row whose knock-outs make the model infeasible (toy model with a forced maintenance reaction ATPM lb 1, rxn_vector [1 1] knocking out both B-producing reactions)
defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-23) MATLAB:matrix:singleSubscriptNumelMismatch "Unable to perform assignment because the left and right sides have a different number of elements." at line 91: solveCobraLP returns stat 0 and obj = [], the status is not checked, [] < .10 is false, and growthrate - gamma = [] is assigned to a lower bound
defects.expected: fitness 0 for that row, as for any knock-out below growth 0.1 (optGeneFitnessTilt, used by optGene, checks isempty(solKO.x) and skips the row)

defects.title: The global hash table HTABLE is required but not documented
defects.trigger: clear global HTABLE; optGeneFitness([1 0], model, 'EX_P', {'R1'; 'R3'}, false)
defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-23) MATLAB:structRefFromNonStruct "Dot indexing is not supported for variables of this type." at line 136; the global MaxKnockOuts is also undocumented
defects.expected: the globals documented, or an empty cache created when HTABLE is unset

notes: Reproduction (gurobi): global HTABLE MaxKnockOuts; HTABLE = java.util.Hashtable; MaxKnockOuts = 2; model = createModel({'EX_A'; 'R1'; 'R3'; 'BIO'; 'EX_P'; 'ATPM'}, {'EX_A'; 'R1'; 'R3'; 'BIO'; 'EX_P'; 'ATPM'}, {' -> A'; 'A -> B'; 'A -> B + P'; 'B -> '; 'P -> '; 'B -> '}, 'lowerBoundList', [0 0 0 0 0 1], 'upperBoundList', [10 1000 1000 1000 1000 1000]); model = changeObjective(model, 'BIO'); optGeneFitness([1 1], model, 'EX_P', {'R1'; 'R3'}, false) -> error at line 91 (the row [1 0] of the same model returns -9.99 correctly). Not a callee defect: solveCobraLP documents no obj value for stat 0. With a solver returning obj = NaN the comparison is also false and the second LP gets a NaN lower bound. Infeasible knock-outs are common in genome-scale searches (non-zero ATPM lower bound). The function has no active src caller (optGene.m line 181 is commented; optGene uses optGeneFitnessTilt), so nothing else is blocked. Probes of the feasible branches (same toy model without ATPM, gurobi) all matched hand derivation: [0 0] -> 0, [1 0] -> -9.99, [0 1] -> 0, [1 1] with MaxKnockOuts 1 -> 0 (skipped), [1 1] with MaxKnockOuts 2 -> 0 (growth 0 < 0.1), memo hit and gene-list path (rxnGeneMat removed, genes g1/g3) give the same values; model.osenseStr is ignored (solveCobraLP maximises by default, the model has no osense field), harmless for growth maximisation. solveCobraLP is called without parameters, so the setGurobiParam/getCobraSolverParams quarantine forms are not reached; deleteModelGenes' cosmetic defects are not reached.
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: line 70 takes growthrate = slnKO.obj without checking the solve status, so an infeasible knockout gives [] and line 91 stops; the only src call, optGene.m:181, is commented out)
